tagline: A connected lifestyle and commerce platform.
summary: Connected commerce platform spanning customer shopping, merchant tools, logistics and related financial services.
statusNote: 1145 Lifestyle is being built. No public web app or store listing has been published on this site yet.

audiences.name: Consumers
audiences.description: People who want to browse, order and pay for goods and services in one place.

audiences.name: Merchants and brand owners
audiences.description: Businesses that want to list products, manage orders and reach customers.

audiences.name: Delivery partners
audiences.description: Drivers and couriers who fulfil deliveries for orders placed on the platform.

capabilities.name: Marketplace
capabilities.description: Browse products from participating merchants, place orders and follow them to delivery.

capabilities.name: Merchant tools
capabilities.description: List products, manage stock and orders, and see how a store is performing.

capabilities.name: Delivery
capabilities.description: Assign, track and complete deliveries for marketplace orders.

capabilities.name: Rides
capabilities.description: Request and manage rides through the same account.

capabilities.name: Financial services
capabilities.description: Wallet and payment features related to shopping on the platform. Details will be published only once a service is released and approved.

requirements.label: Devices
requirements.detail: Not confirmed yet. Supported devices will be listed with the first release.

requirements.label: Account
requirements.detail: A 1145 Lifestyle account, created on the product's own domain. This website never asks for your product sign-in details.

requirements.label: Permissions
requirements.detail: Not confirmed yet. Any permission a module needs will be explained before you are asked to grant it.

platformNote: Each module is documented separately and may reach different platforms at different times.
gettingStarted: There is nothing to install or open yet. When the first module is released, account setup and onboarding steps will be published here.
limitations: No module has been released, so nothing described on this page can be used yet.
Payment and wallet guidance will only be published for services that have actually been released.
